title: Complete flag bundle by tautological kernels
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $F$ a finite locally free $\mathcal O_T$-module of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Define the complete flag bundle $p:\operatorname{Fl}_T(F)\to T$ recursively. For $r=0,1$ take $p=\operatorname{id}_T$ with the empty or one-step filtration. For $r>1$ form $q:P=\mathbf P_T(F)=\operatorname{Proj}_T\operatorname{Sym}F$ with the quotient-line convention [lem-pur-projective-bundle-tautological-geometry]. Its tautological map $q^*F\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal O_P(1)$ sends, on the standard chart where the $j$th coordinate is invertible, a local basis vector $e_i$ to $(X_i/X_j)e_j$. Let $K$ be its kernel, of rank $r-1$, and take $\operatorname{Fl}_T(F)=\operatorname{Fl}_P(K)$ with projection the composite to $T$. The filtration of the pulled-back $K$, followed by $p^*F$, is the universal filtration $0=F_0\subset F_1\subset\cdots\subset F_r=p^*F$ by vector subbundles, with invertible quotients $Q_j=F_j/F_{j-1}$. Here subbundle means that the quotient is locally free. A local splitting of each surjection onto an invertible quotient gives an adapted local frame; no splitting of the filtration on all of the flag bundle is included in this definition.
